scripts.dev: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:design-tokens && pnpm run build:ui-react && pnpm run build:ui-web && pnpm --parallel --filter ./apps/* run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:design-tokens && pnpm run build:ui-react && pnpm run build:ui-web && pnpm --filter ./apps/* run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:design-tokens && pnpm run build:ui-react && pnpm run build:ui-web && pnpm run typecheck:contracts && pnpm run typecheck:design-tokens && pnpm run typecheck:ui-react && pnpm run typecheck:ui-web && pnpm --filter ./apps/* run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter ./apps/* run build
scripts.registry:up: docker volume create microfrontends-lab-registry_verdaccio-storage && docker compose -f infra/verdaccio/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait verdaccio
scripts.packages:build: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:design-tokens && pnpm run build:ui-react && pnpm run build:ui-web
scripts.packages:pack:check: pnpm --dir packages/contracts pack --dry-run --json && pnpm --dir packages/design-tokens pack --dry-run --json && pnpm --dir infra/verdaccio/seed/ui-react-1.0.0 pack --dry-run --json && pnpm --dir packages/ui-react pack --dry-run --json && pnpm --dir packages/ui-web pack --dry-run --json
scripts.bootstrap:local: pnpm run registry:up && pnpm run packages:install && pnpm run packages:build && pnpm run packages:pack:check && pnpm run packages:publish:local && pnpm run workspace:install:local-registry
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
scripts.containers:build: docker compose build shell products account
scripts.containers:up: docker compose up -d --wait shell products account
scripts.containers:down: docker compose stop shell products account
scripts.containers:rebuild:products: docker compose build products && docker compose up -d --no-deps products
